description: This file defines the RecognitionScoreView class, a custom View component used to display recognition results with associated confidence scores in an Android application related to TensorFlow object recognition.

classes.name: RecognitionScoreView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays a list of recognition results with confidence scores on a canvas.

methods.name: RecognitionScoreView
methods.description: Constructor initializing paint objects and text size based on device display metrics.

methods.name: setResults
methods.description: Sets the list of recognition results to display and triggers a view redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render recognition results and background on the canvas.
